annotations.title: Share a track's sheet as a template

description: Shares one of the person's sheets as a template others copy: its tabs, formulas, Glance cards and form go with it; each share is the next version. Only a sheet with nothing of the person's own, since a copy carries everything: set up a fresh track for sharing (start_tracking with forSharing) and add example rows with add_rows and example: true; any other rows get the share refused. Public needs the sheet's schema public, which only the person can do in the app. Works only if the person turned on "Let my assistant share what it builds" in Settings.

description.description: Up to 300 characters: what it tracks and what's in it.
